description: Source code implementing interned string management and symbol handling for the PyTorch library, including symbol interning, namespace management, and symbol string conversions.

classes.name: Symbol
classes.description: Represents a symbolic identifier used within the PyTorch interned string system, supporting namespace management and string conversions.

classes.name: InternedStrings
classes.description: Manages the interning of strings and symbols, providing thread-safe access and namespace handling.

methods.name: domain_prefix
methods.description: Returns the domain prefix string used for namespacing symbols.

methods.name: symbol
methods.description: Returns a Symbol object for a given string, interning it if necessary.

methods.name: string
methods.description: Retrieves the string representations associated with a Symbol.

methods.name: ns
methods.description: Returns the namespace Symbol for a given Symbol.

methods.name: _symbol
methods.description: Interns a string as a Symbol, ensuring it has a namespace.

methods.name: customString
methods.description: Returns the qualified and unqualified string representations of a Symbol.
